description: MBB Bo 105 of the German Army, c/n 6212, gate guardian at the Heeresflugplatz Celle-Wietzenbruch.
Sud-Aviation Alouette II, c/n 1530, preserved at Celle. Sources place this airframe both at Celle and at Köln-Wahn; it is recorded here at Celle and the conflict is flagged in the notes.
Ex-Luftwaffe Transall C-160D held at Celle as a ground instructional airframe inside the airfield.
